purpose: freeze one fail-closed adapter lifecycle, bounded ownership model and fault policy before any production transport adapter is accepted

canonical_payload_hash.algorithm: sha256 over entries sorted by UTF-8 path; for each regular file append LE32 path length, path bytes, LE64 content length and SHA-256(content)

registry_archive_observation.reason: the registry regenerates ZIP timestamps, so raw ZIP SHA-256 changes while all 30 paths and contents remain identical

essl_dependency_lock.build_policy: registry-managed resolution remains disabled; F4.1 must vendor exactly this normalized payload or the exact repository subtree before target adapter code is accepted

common_lifecycle.ready_rule: READY requires a CRC-valid current-session handshake, compatible protocol major, accepted capability hash and fresh local and peer boot IDs
side_effect_gate: request belongs to the current peer boot ID and session
request is new rather than duplicate or stale
remaining deadline is positive at owner dispatch
the physical owner independently accepts its local permission, mode and lease gates
common_lifecycle.boot_change_rule: a changed peer boot ID in READY enters RESETTING; no hardware reset or reconnect may transition directly back to READY
common_lifecycle.quiesce_rule: QUIESCING refuses new side effects, completes or explicitly fails already committed owner operations, and reaches DOWN only after the physical interface is parked
common_lifecycle.fault_rule: any framing invariant, protected-queue exhaustion, ownership violation or session ambiguity enters FAULTED and closes local side effects before diagnostics

classes.name: interactive
classes.overflow: reject admission with BUSY; do not create a side effect

classes.name: telemetry
classes.overflow: drop oldest queued telemetry, enqueue newest and increment the reported dropped counter

classes.name: bulk
classes.overflow: stop admission until receiver credit is available

per_direction_pool.scheduler: strict priority 0 through 4; a lower class never occupies or delays a ready higher-class cell

tx_buffer_ownership.rule: application bytes are immutable after QUEUED; reuse is forbidden until the physical completion or abort path returns the buffer to FREE

rx_buffer_ownership.rule: CRC, length, version, session, replay and deadline validation finish before DISPATCHED; receiver credit is not replenished before FREE

bulk_credit.seed_rule: after READY, the receiver advertises an absolute current-session credit equal to its free bulk receive buffers
bulk_credit.consume_rule: the sender atomically consumes one current-session credit before a bulk cell enters QUEUED
bulk_credit.replenish_rule: the receiver advertises replacement credit only after the corresponding receive buffer returns to FREE
bulk_credit.update_rule: credit is an absolute value scoped by peer boot ID and session; duplicate, stale or previous-session CREDIT messages cannot add capacity
bulk_credit.reset_rule: reset, link loss and boot-ID change immediately set local and advertised credit to zero

duplicate_and_result_policy.pending_duplicate: coalesce with the original operation and return its one terminal typed result
duplicate_and_result_policy.cached_duplicate: return the cached typed result without executing the owner transition again
duplicate_and_result_policy.stale_or_evicted: return STALE_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE and never execute the request
duplicate_and_result_policy.reset_rule: discard pending/results from the old session; old-boot requests remain inadmissible after the new handshake

deadline_policy.start: complete validated receipt of the request
deadline_policy.queue_rule: queueing and retries consume the original deadline; they never restart or extend it
deadline_policy.pre_commit_expiry: return DEADLINE_EXPIRED and do not commit a side effect
deadline_policy.post_commit_expiry: report the actual owner state; never claim cancellation of an already committed transition
deadline_policy.safety_rule: transport deadlines never extend the owner's 100-ms TX lease or any tighter local hardware deadline

liveness.rule: only a CRC-valid PONG in the current boot/session advances liveness; owner-local TX lease expiry remains independent and no later than 100 ms

mailbox_adapters.ready_rule: S3 reads a CRC-valid compatible status with a fresh target boot ID, then sends one zero-side-effect session-open command whose sequence and S3 session ID are acknowledged in a stable CRC-valid status
mailbox_adapters.command_ownership: at most one command per target is outstanding; the target publishes ack_sequence only after full CRC/sequence validation and a stable apply/result decision
mailbox_adapters.status_ownership: the target snapshots all 64 status bytes before serving a read; S3 discards a torn or CRC-invalid snapshot and retries without changing owner state
mailbox_adapters.update_credit: exactly one 128-byte offset-addressed update window may be outstanding; the next window is admitted only after flash read-back acknowledgement
mailbox_adapters.reset_rule: boot-ID change, stale status, bus fault or sequence ambiguity clears the session, outstanding command and update credit and returns the adapter through RESETTING
mailbox_adapters.pack_authority: PACK remains locally fail-closed; loss of S3 cannot admit cells or release protected pack hold
mailbox_adapters.safety_authority: SAFETY owns heartbeat, evidence and lease expiry and asserts FAULT_KILL when its local contract is violated

link_loss_actions.required_action: C5 parks its interface and disables all TX requests; its independent owner lease expires within 100 ms; S3 marks C5 state unknown and rejects new C5 side effects
RP parks active paths and disables all TX requests; its independent owner lease expires within 100 ms; S3 marks RP state unknown and rejects new RP side effects
PACK preserves its local protection/hold decision; S3 marks pack state stale and cannot admit cells, release hold or infer admission from the lost link
SAFETY revokes the active lease and asserts FAULT_KILL under its 200-ms heartbeat-gap contract; S3 cannot restore RUN over the link

reviewed_now: fixed queue reservations and ownership cycles
credit, duplicate, deadline and reset rules
exact ESSL version, source commit and normalized component payload
not_yet_claimed: wire, DMA, interrupt or clock-stretching execution
latency, throughput, coexistence or physical reset recovery
